articles.title: Securitize remains in the red even as record quarter fuels public listing plans
articles.snippet: The tokenization platform reported record quarterly revenue but continued to post losses as it invested in growth and public-company preparations tied to its merger with Cantor Equity Partners II.

articles.title: Telegram group at center of Jane Street insider-trading allegations in Terra collapse
articles.snippet: Newly unsealed filings detail a private chat dubbed ‘Bryce’s Secret’ that Terraform’s estate says gave Jane Street an informational edge before UST’s collapse.

articles.title: Too many cooks: How regulatory infighting is choking the UK's crypto hub ambitions
articles.snippet: While the FCA opens its doors to market pilots, structural delays and legislative friction are fueling industry frustration over a framework trailing behind the U.S. and Europe.

articles.title: Bitfinex traders double down on bitcoin during five-day slide as longs hit 2.5-year high
articles.snippet: Margin longs on Bitfinex have climbed to a two-and-a-half year high as bitcoin struggles below key technical resistance near $78,000.

articles.title: Despite Trump’s pledge, a CBDC is being explored behind closed doors, says former CTFC chair
articles.snippet: Publicly, the U.S. has fiercely opposed a Central Bank Digital Currency, but former CFTC Chairman Timothy Massad said it is inevitable and there will be one sooner or later.
